about_the_game:
Another great DLC from the master of the interiors, WizardOfID. This time, he's turned his talents to an old, abandoned hospital and asylum mini kit. Designed to complement the Asylum Furnishings DLC, but usable for many genres from Horror, Post Apocalyptic through to Modern day.


Fully modular, the pack includes assets to make rooms and buildings easily, and has enough variation to make wards, padded cells, offices and much more; all ready to be populated with assets from other DLC's or your own models.

Included in this mini kit you'll find corridors, rooms, t-junctions, corners and cross junctions, and several doors, both static and animated. Each set of building assets comes in three colour variations so you can add your own take on your old hospital.
